title: The Rose Window
description: A picture made of quest nodes: one boss, twelve apostles, twelve
prophets, twelve saints and five petals, drawn by position and
glazed in list order by a LINEAR chapter.
This one is meant to be looked at rather than read. Open the
chapter, then walk it a node at a time with
`/tasked complete <quest>` -- the window fills in as the list
advances, which is the whole demonstration: a LINEAR chapter's
order being a drawing as well as a progression.
